#750 · Draft Horse Pokémon

Mudsdale

Ground

Alola · Generation 7

Mudsdale is a Ground-type Draft Horse Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 2.5 m tall and weighs 920 kg. It evolves from Mudbray. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 500.
